title: Codex Scientiae schema registry entry
description: One row of the schema registry: a schema the engine ships, described by the parts a consumer needs in order to resolve and trust it. The registry is a published view of what the in-memory SchemaCatalog holds, so this row carries only what is derivable from the schema document itself -- nothing about where the file sits, which would go stale on a move.

id.description: The schema's own $id. The address every other artifact cites it by.

file.description: Filename the schema ships as, without a directory. The catalog indexes by this and by its stem, so a consumer can resolve either way.

draft.description: The meta-schema this document declares, from its own $schema. Recorded because the draft decides how the document is interpreted.

title.description: The schema's title, when it declares one.

identity.description: The schema's own x-identity, when it declares one. Present here means the schema can back a registry; absent means it cannot be keyed.
